question: Which unicellular organism acquires food by a process in which cells absorb external material by engulfing it with the cell membrane?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Amoeba.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Amoeba**, the cell membrane help in** engulfing the food **during the process called **endocytosis.**
 
• Amoeba is **a unicellular organism that has the ability to change its shape**.
 
• They are usually found in** water bodies such as ponds, lakes, and slow-moving rivers.**
 
• Sometimes, these **unicellular organisms** can also make their way inside the human body and cause **various illnesses**.
 
• Amoebae do not form a single** taxonomic group; **instead, they are found in every major **lineage of eukaryotic organisms.**** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b3e0b4ffbde1dbcc3b280038b26b425aba8bf3a47320f7eca79712a8781527.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Yeast is **a single-cell organism, called Saccharomyces cerevisiae**, which needs food, warmth, and moisture to thrive.
 
• ​Volvox is **a genus of green algae containing around 20 species of freshwater algae**.
 
• Spirogyra, (genus Spirogyra), **any member of a genus of some 400 species of free-floating green algae (division Chlorophyta) found in freshwater environments around the world**. 
 
• A spirogyra is **a plant** because of the presence of chlorophyll which allows it to make its own food.
